description: This file defines a Java interface named DataBuffer that specifies methods for adding values, retrieving stored values, and resetting the buffer. It also includes static utility methods for common statistical computations such as sum, average, and standard deviation.

classes.name: DataBuffer
classes.description: An interface specifying methods for managing a buffer of double values and static utility methods for statistical calculations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a double value to the buffer.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves all values stored in the buffer as an array of doubles.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the buffer to its initial empty state.

methods.name: sum
methods.description: Calculates the sum of an array of doubles.

methods.name: average
methods.description: Calculates the average of an array of doubles.

methods.name: getStandardDeviation
methods.description: Calculates the standard deviation of an array of doubles.
